Welcome, and no worries—everyone starts somewhere! Here’s a simple starting path on our app:

Sign up & verify: Download the app, create an account, complete your profile (photo, bio, location) and do the quick ID check via Stripe.
Explore & rent: Browse items available in the UK or US and request a rental once verified.
Or start lending: Tap + to list an item—add clear photos (ideally worn), detailed fit info, and set your price and availability. We review listings before they go live.
Boost your profile: Use a friendly profile picture and “About me” so renters trust you and feel comfortable booking from you.

That’s your basic roadmap: set up profile → verify → either rent or list your first item.

ByRo Bot · AI says:

Here are the main options, in plain language:

Paying & spending

Use your Wallet balance (lending earnings) to pay for rentals, or withdraw it to your bank and then pay by card.
Use credits: they apply automatically at checkout and go back to your balance if a rental is rejected, cancelled, or expires.

Lending tiers & perks

As a lender you move through Active → Muse → Pro based on how many successful rentals you do and how reliable you are.
Higher tiers get profile badges, better search visibility, community perks, and for Pros, priority/dedicated support.

Renting items

You can message lenders on each listing to ask questions.
You can filter for trusted lenders (Muse & Pro, good response/acceptance rates, reviews).
Some high‑value items need you to have a certain number of reviews and must be collected in person rather than posted.

Selling items

Only Verified Lenders can sell.
Buyer sends a purchase request; once accepted, the sale is final (no refunds).
Seller pays a 12% fee, buyer 10%.

Pricing your rentals

You set daily, weekly, and monthly prices; we show suggested prices you can use or edit.
You can add cleaning fees (mainly for dry‑clean‑only items) and a postage fee if you offer Royal Mail tracked delivery.
Prices are non‑negotiable in chat.

Delivery & collection

Choose between posting the item (tracked, insured, on time) or in‑person collection.
You can switch between delivery and collection after booking by adjusting postage or using a partial refund.

Building trust as a lender

Add a profile picture and a friendly bio to look more genuine and approachable.
Sharing who you are and why you lend helps renters feel safe choosing your wardrobe.

If you tell me whether you’re more interested in renting, lending, or selling, I can break down just those options in even simpler steps.

What's the return policy if it turns out not to be right for me?

Sent · Just now

ByRo Bot · AI

ByRo Bot · AI says:

If a rental isn’t right for you (for example, the fit isn’t quite working):

Refunds depend on the lender’s policy. Many state in their bio if they offer fit-related refunds; if unsure, message them before booking.
When refunds are given for fit, they’re issued as app credit only (no cash), rental days only, and delivery/cleaning fees are non‑refundable.
To request a refund for an issue, you must:
Report it in the app by 23:59 on the first day of your rental (your inspection window), and
Return the item within 24 hours of delivery/collection.
Approved refunds (not fit-credit ones) are sent back to your original payment method within about 8 working days, and only cover the rental cost (platform service fees are non‑refundable).
If you miss the inspection window, a refund is only possible if the lender voluntarily agrees and issues it in‑app.

So in short: if it’s “not right for you,” you may be able to get a refund depending on the lender’s stated policy, but it will usually be app credit and you must report and return the item very quickly to stay eligible.
